description: CONTINGENCY PLAN 1.1 - FIXED: TRANSFER LEARNING FROM BEST SYNTHETIC CHECKPOINT. CRITICAL FIX: Using ckpt-88 (best_model, epoch 44, PSNR 30.91 dB) instead of ckpt-96 (latest, epoch 48, overfitted). From-scratch training plateaued at 21.71 dB (gap 0.58 dB to DocEnTR). Expected boost: +1.5-2.0 dB → Final 23.2-23.7 dB (BEAT SOTA).

experiment_metadata.methodology: Fine-tune synthetic checkpoint on pure DIBCO (Contingency Plan 1.1)
experiment_metadata.architecture: Enhanced Generator + Enhanced V2 Fixed Discriminator
experiment_metadata.novelty: Transfer learning from synthetic → real DIBCO adaptation
experiment_metadata.training_strategy: TRANSFER LEARNING with frozen encoder early layers

baseline_checkpoint.name: production_v3_academic_split_70_15_15
baseline_checkpoint.rationale: Synthetic checkpoint has learned robust low-level features (edges, strokes, texture) that transfer well to real DIBCO degradation patterns

from_scratch_baseline.root_cause: Dataset too small (256 samples) for 39.2M param model from scratch

transfer_learning_strategy.fine_tune_decoder: Full decoder + discriminator adaptation to DIBCO

expected_boost.mechanism: Synthetic checkpoint provides strong visual quality baseline → Fine-tuning adapts to DIBCO-specific degradation patterns

success_criteria.minimum: PSNR ≥ 22.5 dB (0.21 dB improvement over DocEnTR)
success_criteria.target: PSNR ≥ 23.0 dB (0.71 dB improvement, publishable Q1)
success_criteria.superior: PSNR ≥ 24.0 dB (1.71 dB improvement, strong novelty claim)

fallback_plan.if_psnr_22_23: Acceptable, publishable in Q2 venue with other contributions (F-measure, SSIM, visual quality)
fallback_plan.if_psnr_21_22: Execute Plan 1.2 (Progressive fine-tuning) or Plan 1.3 (Ensemble inference)
fallback_plan.if_psnr_below_21: Critical failure, need Plan 2 (Heavy augmentation) or Plan 3 (Architecture redesign)

architecture_advantages.transfer_learning: Leverage synthetic training (10K+ samples) → Fine-tune on small DIBCO (256 samples)
architecture_advantages.dual_modal_discriminator: Evaluates both visual quality AND HTR readability
architecture_advantages.frozen_encoder: Retain robust low-level features, adapt high-level semantic understanding
architecture_advantages.htr_oriented_loss: RecFeat loss guides restoration toward readable output
architecture_advantages.perceptual_loss: VGG-based perceptual loss preserves high-freq details

risk_mitigation.catastrophic_forgetting: Mitigated by frozen encoder + low LR
risk_mitigation.domain_shift: Synthetic → Real adaptation gradual via warmup
